'''Arn Tan Yolar''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] who worked as a weaponry [[Merchant/Legends|merchant]] on [[Voss]] during the [[Galactic War]]. There he had a small shop, where he sold weapons such as [[Blaster/Legends|blasters]].
